---
name: stack-bootstrap
description: Bootstrap the smallest VenturaSocial Python structure for the approved authorized social-data MVP using declared stack needs. Use when the repository is ready to move from incubation docs to executable code. Do not use when a functional integration already exists or the task is only product scoping.
---

# Stack bootstrap

- Confirm the approved official API and use case before adding dependencies.
- Add only packages required by the first authorized data path.
- Separate provider adapters domain analysis tests and synthetic fixtures.
- Keep tokens raw exports and private user data out of Git.
- Add deterministic tests using mocked provider responses.
- Document retention rate limits and required configuration.
- Reuse the shared repository CI standard.
